title.hg: Periods 101: Actually ho kya raha hai

subtitle.en: The first period, explained without the whispering

hook.en: Roughly half of all people have periods at some point in their lives, yet it is still discussed in whispers. Let's say it out loud.
hook.hg: Duniya ke lagbhag aadhe logon ko life mein kabhi na kabhi periods aate hain, phir bhi baat sirf dheemi awaaz mein hoti hai. Chalo, khulke bolte hain.

objectives.en: Explain what a period is and why the body has one.
objectives.hg: Samjha sako ki period kya hai aur body mein yeh kyun hota hai.

objectives.en: Know what is normal for a first period and the early cycles.
objectives.hg: Jaano ki first period aur shuruaati cycles mein kya-kya normal hai.

objectives.en: Decide whom to tell and what to keep ready.
objectives.hg: Decide karo ki kisko batana hai aur kya ready rakhna hai.

body.en: Inside the lower belly is the uterus, a small, strong, pear-shaped organ. Every month or so its inner lining grows thicker and fills with blood vessels, getting ready in case a pregnancy ever begins. When there is no pregnancy, the body does not need that lining, so it breaks down and flows out through the vagina as blood and tissue. That flow is a period, also called menstruation. It is not an injury and not an illness. It is a sign that the body is growing up and working as it should.
body.hg: Pet ke nichle hisse mein uterus hota hai, ek chhota, strong, nashpati ki shape ka organ. Lagbhag har mahine iski andar ki lining moti hoti hai aur usme blood vessels bhar jaati hain, taaki kabhi pregnancy shuru ho toh body ready rahe. Jab pregnancy nahi hoti, toh body ko us lining ki zaroorat nahi rehti. Woh lining toot kar blood aur tissue ke roop mein vagina ke raaste bahar aa jaati hai. Isi flow ko period ya menstruation kehte hain. Yeh na chot hai, na bimari. Yeh sign hai ki body badi ho rahi hai aur sahi kaam kar rahi hai.

h.en: When it starts and what it looks like
h.hg: Kab start hota hai aur kaisa dikhta hai

body.en: The first period usually arrives about two years after the breasts begin to develop, often somewhere between ages 10 and 15. Arriving earlier or later than your friends is common. The blood can be bright red, dark red or brown, and brown spotting at the start or end is just older blood. Bleeding usually lasts 2 to 7 days. The total amount is only a few tablespoons, even though it can look like much more on a pad. See a doctor if there is no period by age 15.
body.hg: First period usually breasts develop hona shuru hone ke lagbhag do saal baad aata hai, aksar 10 se 15 saal ki age ke beech. Friends se pehle ya baad mein aana bilkul common hai. Blood bright red, dark red ya brown ho sakta hai. Start ya end mein brown spotting bas purana blood hota hai. Bleeding usually 2 se 7 din chalti hai. Poore period mein total amount bas kuch tablespoons hoti hai, chahe pad pe bahut zyada lage. Agar 15 saal ki age tak period na aaye, toh doctor ko dikhao.

h.en: The first couple of years are irregular
h.hg: Pehle ek-do saal irregular rehte hain

body.en: A new cycle rarely runs like a clock. In the first years after the first period, the gap from the start of one period to the start of the next can be anywhere from 21 to 45 days, and a month may even get skipped. This happens because the hormone signals between the brain and the ovaries are still settling. Many people also notice a clear or white discharge in their underwear for months before the first period. That is the vagina cleaning itself, and it is normal.
body.hg: Naya cycle ghadi ki tarah shayad hi chalta hai. First period ke baad ke shuruaati saalon mein ek period start hone se agla start hone tak ka gap 21 se 45 din tak kuch bhi ho sakta hai, aur kabhi koi mahina skip bhi ho sakta hai. Aisa isliye hota hai kyunki brain aur ovaries ke beech hormone signals abhi settle ho rahe hote hain. Bahut logon ko first period se kai mahine pehle underwear pe clear ya white discharge bhi dikhta hai. Yeh vagina ka khud ko saaf rakhne ka tareeka hai, aur bilkul normal hai.

body.en: Periods are easier when you are not handling them alone. Pick one trusted adult, such as your mother, father, an older sister, an aunt or a school teacher, and tell them when it starts or even before. Keep a small kit in your school bag: two pads, a spare pair of underwear and a paper bag for disposal. If the first period arrives at school, ask a teacher or the school office for a pad. Everyone who has periods has had a first one, so they will understand.
body.hg: Periods tab easy lagte hain jab aap inhe akele handle nahi kar rahe hote. Ek trusted adult chuno, jaise mummy, papa, badi behen, mausi-bua ya school teacher, aur period start hote hi ya usse pehle hi unhe bata do. School bag mein ek chhoti kit rakho: do pads, ek extra underwear aur pad phenkne ke liye paper bag. Agar first period school mein aa jaye, toh teacher ya school office se pad maang lo. Jinhe bhi periods aate hain, unka bhi kabhi first period aaya tha, toh woh samjhenge.

claim.en: Once a girl gets her period, she has become a woman.
claim.hg: Period aate hi ladki aurat ban jaati hai.

fact.en: A first period only means the reproductive system has begun to mature. The person is still a child whose body, brain and emotions will keep growing for many years.
fact.hg: First period bas yeh batata hai ki reproductive system mature hona start hua hai. Woh ab bhi ek bachchi hai jiski body, brain aur emotions kai saal tak grow karte rahenge.

takeaways.en: A period is the uterus lining leaving the body through the vagina, and it is healthy, not an illness.
takeaways.hg: Period mein uterus ki lining vagina ke raaste bahar aati hai; yeh healthy hai, bimari nahi.

takeaways.en: First periods usually come between 10 and 15 and are often irregular for the first couple of years.
takeaways.hg: First period usually 10 se 15 ki age mein aata hai aur pehle ek-do saal aksar irregular rehta hai.

takeaways.en: A trusted adult and a small pad kit make the first period far easier.
takeaways.hg: Ek trusted adult aur ek chhoti pad kit first period ko bahut easy bana dete hain.

activity.en: Make your period kit today: put two pads, spare underwear and a paper bag in a small pouch, and decide which adult you would tell first.
activity.hg: Aaj hi apni period kit banao: ek chhote pouch mein do pads, extra underwear aur paper bag rakho, aur decide karo ki sabse pehle kis adult ko bataoge.

q.en: What comes out of the body during a period?
q.hg: Period ke dauraan body se kya bahar aata hai?

options.en: Dirty blood the body has rejected
options.hg: Ganda blood jo body ne reject kiya hai

options.en: The lining of the uterus, as blood and tissue
options.hg: Uterus ki lining, blood aur tissue ke roop mein

options.en: Blood from a wound inside the belly
options.hg: Pet ke andar ke kisi ghaav ka blood

options.en: Extra blood the body made by mistake
options.hg: Extra blood jo body ne galti se bana liya

explain.en: The uterus builds a lining each cycle and sheds it when there is no pregnancy. It is ordinary blood and tissue, not dirt or injury.
explain.hg: Uterus har cycle mein ek lining banata hai aur pregnancy na hone par use bahar nikaal deta hai. Yeh ordinary blood aur tissue hai, gandagi ya chot nahi.

q.en: It is common for periods to be irregular in the first couple of years.
q.hg: Pehle ek-do saal mein periods ka irregular hona common hai.

options.en: True
False

explain.en: The hormone signals between the brain and ovaries take time to settle, so early cycles can range from 21 to 45 days.
explain.hg: Brain aur ovaries ke beech hormone signals ko settle hone mein time lagta hai, isliye shuruaati cycles 21 se 45 din tak ke ho sakte hain.

title.en: Pads, Hygiene and a Normal School Day
title.hg: Pads, Hygiene aur ek Normal School Day

subtitle.en: Handling a period without missing out on life
subtitle.hg: Life pause kiye bina period handle karna

hook.en: A period does not need a day off from life. It needs a pad, a plan and zero embarrassment.
hook.hg: Period ke liye life se chhutti nahi chahiye. Chahiye bas ek pad, ek plan aur zero sharam.

objectives.en: Use, change and dispose of a pad correctly.
objectives.hg: Pad sahi tareeke se lagana, change karna aur dispose karna seekho.

objectives.en: Stay clean and comfortable without products you do not need.
objectives.hg: Bina faltu products ke clean aur comfortable rehna jaano.

objectives.en: Handle stains and support others kindly.
objectives.hg: Stain lage toh kya karna hai aur doosron ko support kaise karna hai, yeh samjho.

body.en: A sanitary pad sticks to the inside of your underwear and soaks up the flow. Peel off the paper strip, press the sticky side onto the underwear, and fold the wings, if it has them, around the sides. Change it about every 4 to 6 hours, or sooner if it feels wet or heavy, even on light days. Longer pads work well at night. Reusable cloth pads are also fine if they are washed with soap and water and dried completely in sunlight before the next use. Tampons and menstrual cups are other options you can learn about when you are older.
body.hg: Sanitary pad underwear ke andar chipakta hai aur flow soak kar leta hai. Paper strip hatao, sticky side underwear pe press karo, aur agar wings hain toh unhe sides pe fold kar do. Pad lagbhag har 4 se 6 ghante mein change karo, aur geela ya heavy lage toh usse pehle bhi, chahe flow light hi ho. Raat ke liye lambe pads achhe rehte hain. Reusable cloth pads bhi theek hain, bas unhe sabun-paani se dhokar dhoop mein poori tarah sukhana zaroori hai. Tampons aur menstrual cups doosre options hain, jinke baare mein aap thoda bade hokar seekh sakte ho.

body.en: Bathe every day during your period; warm water can even ease cramps. Wash the outer area, called the vulva, with plain water, and wipe from front to back after using the toilet. The vagina cleans itself from the inside, so scented washes, sprays and powders are not needed and can irritate the skin. Wash your hands before and after changing a pad. Wrap the used pad in paper or its wrapper and put it in a dustbin. Never flush it, because it blocks the toilet. A slight smell is normal and others cannot notice it.
body.hg: Period mein roz nahao; gungune paani se toh cramps mein bhi aaram milta hai. Bahar ke area yaani vulva ko plain paani se dho lo, aur toilet ke baad aage se peeche ki taraf wipe karo. Vagina andar se khud ko clean rakhti hai, isliye scented wash, spray aur powder ki zaroorat nahi; ulta inse skin irritate ho sakti hai. Pad change karne se pehle aur baad mein haath dho lo. Used pad ko paper ya uske wrapper mein lapet kar dustbin mein daalo. Kabhi flush mat karo, toilet block ho jaata hai. Halki smell normal hai aur doosron ko pata nahi chalti.

body.en: You can go to school, play sports, dance, cycle, cook, eat any food and wash your hair on your period. Movement often makes cramps feel better. Leaks happen to almost everyone at some point. If your uniform gets stained, tie a sweater around your waist, ask a friend or teacher for a pad, and rinse the stain later with cold water, which works better than hot. Some families ask girls to stay out of the kitchen or prayer room during periods. These are customs, not medical rules; a period does not make anyone impure.
body.hg: Period mein aap school ja sakte ho, sports khel sakte ho, dance, cycling, cooking kar sakte ho, kuch bhi kha sakte ho aur baal dho sakte ho. Movement se aksar cramps better feel hote hain. Leak hona lagbhag sabke saath kabhi na kabhi hota hai. Uniform pe stain lag jaye toh kamar pe sweater baandh lo, kisi friend ya teacher se pad maango, aur baad mein stain thande paani se dho lo, jo garam paani se better kaam karta hai. Kuch families mein periods ke time kitchen ya pooja-ghar mein jaane se mana kiya jaata hai. Yeh customs hain, medical rules nahi; period se koi impure nahi hota.

h.en: Being a good friend about periods
h.hg: Periods ke maamle mein achha dost banna

body.en: Not everyone gets periods, but everyone can make them easier. If you see a stain on someone's clothes, tell them quietly instead of pointing or laughing. Share a pad if you have one. Never tease someone for carrying pads or for feeling tired or cranky. Boys can help too, by buying pads for a sister without fuss, by not making jokes, and by stopping friends who do. Cramps and tiredness are real, so offering to carry a bag or share class notes is simple kindness.
body.hg: Periods sabko nahi aate, par inhe easy har koi bana sakta hai. Kisi ke kapdon pe stain dikhe toh point karne ya hasne ke bajaye chupchaap bata do. Aapke paas pad ho toh share kar do. Pad carry karne pe ya thakaan aur chidchidepan pe kisi ko kabhi tease mat karo. Ladke bhi help kar sakte hain: behen ke liye bina jhijhak pads khareed kar, jokes na maar kar, aur jokes maarne wale doston ko rok kar. Cramps aur thakaan real hoti hai, toh bag utha dena ya class notes share kar dena simple si kindness hai.

claim.en: A pad needs changing only when it is completely full.
claim.hg: Pad tabhi change karna chahiye jab woh poora bhar jaye.

fact.en: Change a pad about every 4 to 6 hours even if it is not full. Wearing one for too long causes smell, dampness, rashes and skin irritation.
fact.hg: Pad full na ho tab bhi use lagbhag har 4 se 6 ghante mein change karo. Bahut der tak ek hi pad lagaye rakhne se smell, geelapan, rashes aur skin irritation hoti hai.

takeaways.en: Change pads every 4 to 6 hours, wrap used ones in paper and bin them, never flush.
takeaways.hg: Pad har 4 se 6 ghante mein change karo, used pad paper mein lapet kar dustbin mein daalo, flush kabhi nahi.

takeaways.en: Daily bathing and plain water are enough; scented products are not needed.
takeaways.hg: Roz nahana aur plain paani kaafi hai; scented products ki zaroorat nahi.

takeaways.en: School, sport, cooking and bathing are all fine during a period, and nobody deserves teasing for one.
takeaways.hg: Period mein school, sports, cooking aur nahana sab theek hai, aur is pe kisi ko tease karna galat hai.

activity.en: Check your school washroom: is there water, a covered dustbin and a place to get a pad? If something is missing, tell a teacher along with a friend.
activity.hg: Apne school ka washroom check karo: paani, dhakkan wala dustbin aur pad milne ki jagah hai kya? Kuch missing ho toh ek friend ke saath jaakar teacher ko batao.

q.en: What is the right way to dispose of a used pad?
q.hg: Used pad dispose karne ka sahi tareeka kya hai?

options.en: Flush it down the toilet
Leave it uncovered in a corner of the washroom
options.hg: Washroom ke kone mein khula chhod dena

options.en: Wrap it in paper and put it in a dustbin
options.hg: Paper mein lapet kar dustbin mein daalna

options.en: Keep it on until you reach home, however long that takes
options.hg: Ghar pahunchne tak lagaye rakhna, chahe kitni bhi der ho

explain.en: Wrapping and binning is clean and safe. Flushing blocks drains, and wearing a pad for too long irritates the skin.
explain.hg: Lapet kar dustbin mein daalna clean aur safe hai. Flush karne se drains block hoti hain aur bahut der pad lagaye rakhne se skin irritate hoti hai.

q.en: During lunch break you notice a stain on a classmate's skirt. What is the best thing to do?
q.hg: Lunch break mein aapko ek classmate ki skirt pe stain dikhta hai. Best kya karna hoga?

options.en: Tell her quietly and offer a pad or a sweater
options.hg: Use chupchaap batana aur pad ya sweater offer karna

options.en: Tell the whole group so that someone can help
options.hg: Poore group ko bata dena taaki koi help kar de

options.en: Say nothing, because it is not your business
options.hg: Kuch na kehna, kyunki yeh aapka matter nahi

explain.en: A quiet word protects her privacy and lets her fix it quickly. Announcing it embarrasses her, and silence leaves her to find out later.
explain.hg: Chupchaap batane se uski privacy safe rehti hai aur woh jaldi fix kar leti hai. Sabke saamne bolne se embarrassment hoti hai, aur chup rehne par use baad mein pata chalta hai.

title.en: The Cycle Decoded: Four Phases, Four Hormones
title.hg: Cycle Decoded: Chaar Phases, Chaar Hormones

subtitle.en: What the body is doing on the days you are not bleeding
subtitle.hg: Jin dino bleeding nahi hoti, un dino body kya kar rahi hoti hai

hook.en: Your period is only the visible week of a month-long hormone relay. Here is what happens on the other days.
hook.hg: Period toh mahine bhar chalne wali hormone relay ka bas dikhne wala hafta hai. Baaki dino mein kya hota hai, yeh dekho.

objectives.en: Name the four phases of the menstrual cycle in order.
objectives.hg: Menstrual cycle ke chaaron phases order mein bata sako.

objectives.en: Describe what FSH, LH, estrogen and progesterone each do.
objectives.hg: Samjha sako ki FSH, LH, estrogen aur progesterone kya-kya karte hain.

objectives.en: Explain why tracking helps your health but cannot be trusted to prevent pregnancy.
objectives.hg: Samjho ki tracking health ke liye useful hai, par pregnancy rokne ke liye reliable nahi.

body.en: A cycle is counted from the first day of bleeding to the day before the next period starts. Typical cycles are 21 to 35 days in adults and can be 21 to 45 days in the first years. During bleeding, estrogen and progesterone are low, which is why energy can dip. Meanwhile the brain's pituitary gland releases FSH, follicle-stimulating hormone, which tells the ovaries to ripen a few egg-containing sacs called follicles. The growing follicles make estrogen, and estrogen rebuilds the uterus lining.
body.hg: Cycle ki ginti bleeding ke pehle din se agla period start hone se ek din pehle tak hoti hai. Adults mein cycle usually 21 se 35 din ka hota hai, aur shuruaati saalon mein 21 se 45 din ka ho sakta hai. Bleeding ke dino mein estrogen aur progesterone low rehte hain, isiliye energy down lag sakti hai. Isi beech brain ki pituitary gland FSH (follicle-stimulating hormone) release karti hai, jo ovaries ko signal deta hai ki egg wali kuch thailiyan, yaani follicles, ripe karo. Badhte follicles estrogen banate hain, aur estrogen uterus ki lining dobara build karta hai.

body.en: When estrogen peaks, the pituitary releases a sudden surge of LH, luteinising hormone. That surge makes one ovary release a mature egg. This is ovulation. The egg survives for about a day. Ovulation usually happens roughly two weeks before the next period, not on a fixed calendar date, and it shifts with stress, illness, travel and age. Around this time vaginal discharge often becomes clear, slippery and stretchy, like raw egg white. Some people feel a brief one-sided twinge in the lower abdomen.
body.hg: Jab estrogen peak pe pahunchta hai, toh pituitary achanak bahut saara LH (luteinising hormone) release karti hai. Is surge se ek ovary mature egg release kar deti hai. Isko ovulation kehte hain. Egg lagbhag ek din zinda rehta hai. Ovulation usually agle period se kareeb do hafte pehle hota hai, calendar ki kisi fixed date pe nahi, aur stress, bimari, travel aur age ke saath aage-peeche hota rehta hai. In dino vaginal discharge aksar clear, slippery aur stretchy ho jaata hai, kachche ande ki safedi jaisa. Kuch logon ko lower abdomen mein ek side halki si chubhan feel hoti hai.

h.en: The luteal phase and the next period

body.en: After ovulation, the empty follicle turns into the corpus luteum and makes progesterone. Progesterone keeps the lining thick and stable. Discharge becomes thicker and creamier, and some people notice sore breasts, bloating, pimples or mood changes. If the egg is not fertilised, the corpus luteum shrinks after about two weeks, progesterone and estrogen fall, and the lining sheds. That is the next Day 1. The luteal phase is fairly steady in length; most variation in cycle length comes from the phase before ovulation.
body.hg: Ovulation ke baad khaali follicle corpus luteum ban jaata hai aur progesterone banane lagta hai. Progesterone lining ko thick aur stable rakhta hai. Discharge gaadha aur creamy ho jaata hai, aur kuch logon ko breasts mein dard, bloating, pimples ya mood changes feel hote hain. Agar egg fertilise nahi hota, toh kareeb do hafte baad corpus luteum shrink ho jaata hai, progesterone aur estrogen gir jaate hain, aur lining shed hone lagti hai. Yahi agla Day 1 hai. Luteal phase ki length kaafi steady rehti hai; cycle length ka zyadatar farak ovulation se pehle wale phase se aata hai.

h.en: Tracking: useful for health, not for 'safe days'
h.hg: Tracking: health ke liye useful, 'safe days' ke liye nahi

body.en: Noting the first day of each period, how long bleeding lasts, pain and mood for a few months shows your own pattern. It helps you carry pads on time and gives a doctor real information if something changes. What tracking cannot do is tell you reliably when pregnancy is impossible. Ovulation moves from cycle to cycle, sperm can survive inside the body for several days, and teenage cycles are especially unpredictable. Apps only estimate. Calendar or 'safe days' calculations are not reliable contraception.
body.hg: Kuch mahine tak har period ka first day, bleeding kitne din chali, pain aur mood note karte raho toh aapka apna pattern dikhne lagta hai. Isse aap time pe pads carry kar paate ho, aur kuch change ho toh doctor ko solid info milti hai. Par tracking yeh reliably nahi bata sakti ki kin dino pregnancy impossible hai. Ovulation har cycle mein aage-peeche hota hai, sperm body ke andar kai din zinda reh sakte hain, aur teenage cycles toh khaas taur pe unpredictable hote hain. Apps sirf estimate karte hain. Calendar ya 'safe days' ka hisaab reliable contraception nahi hai.

claim.en: Every healthy cycle is exactly 28 days, with ovulation on day 14.
claim.hg: Har healthy cycle exactly 28 din ka hota hai aur ovulation day 14 pe hota hai.

fact.en: Twenty-eight is only a textbook average. Healthy adult cycles range from 21 to 35 days, and ovulation day changes from person to person and from month to month.
fact.hg: 28 din sirf textbook wala average hai. Adults ke healthy cycles 21 se 35 din ke hote hain, aur ovulation ka din har insaan mein aur har mahine badalta rehta hai.

takeaways.en: The cycle runs through bleeding, the follicular phase, ovulation and the luteal phase.
takeaways.hg: Cycle mein chaar phases hote hain: bleeding, follicular phase, ovulation aur luteal phase.

takeaways.en: FSH ripens follicles, estrogen builds the lining, LH triggers ovulation and progesterone maintains the lining.
takeaways.hg: FSH follicles ripe karta hai, estrogen lining banata hai, LH ovulation trigger karta hai aur progesterone lining maintain karta hai.

takeaways.en: Tracking shows your pattern, but calendar calculations are not reliable contraception.
takeaways.hg: Tracking se aapka pattern pata chalta hai, par calendar ka hisaab reliable contraception nahi hai.

activity.en: For the next three cycles, note the start date, number of bleeding days and any symptoms in the Period Lab or a notebook, then look for your own pattern.
activity.hg: Agle teen cycles tak Period Lab ya ek notebook mein start date, bleeding ke din aur symptoms note karo, phir apna pattern dhoondho.

q.en: Which hormone keeps the uterus lining thick after ovulation?
q.hg: Ovulation ke baad kaunsa hormone uterus ki lining ko thick rakhta hai?

options.en: FSH
Adrenaline
Insulin
Progesterone

explain.en: The corpus luteum makes progesterone after ovulation. When progesterone falls, the lining sheds and a period begins.
explain.hg: Ovulation ke baad corpus luteum progesterone banata hai. Progesterone girte hi lining shed hoti hai aur period start ho jaata hai.

q.en: A period-tracking app can reliably tell you the days when pregnancy cannot happen.
q.hg: Period-tracking app reliably bata sakta hai ki kin dino pregnancy nahi ho sakti.

options.en: True
False

explain.en: Apps estimate from past cycles, but ovulation shifts and sperm survive for days. Calendar calculations are not reliable contraception.
explain.hg: Apps purane cycles se estimate karte hain, par ovulation shift hota rehta hai aur sperm kai din zinda rehte hain. Calendar ka hisaab reliable contraception nahi hai.

title.en: Cramps, PMS and Mood: What Helps
title.hg: Cramps, PMS aur Mood: Kya Kaam Aata Hai

subtitle.en: Period pain has a chemical cause and real solutions
subtitle.hg: Period pain ka ek chemical reason hai, aur real solutions bhi

hook.en: Period pain is real, it has a chemical cause, and 'just bear it' is not a treatment plan.
hook.hg: Period pain real hai, uska ek chemical reason hai, aur 'bas seh lo' koi treatment plan nahi hai.

objectives.hg: Samjha sako ki cramps kyun hote hain.

objectives.en: List practical things that ease period pain.
objectives.hg: Period pain mein aaram dene wale practical upaay gina sako.

objectives.en: Tell PMS from PMDD and know when to see a doctor.
objectives.hg: PMS aur PMDD ka farak jaano aur samjho ki doctor ke paas kab jaana hai.

body.en: To shed its lining, the uterus, which is a muscle, squeezes. The squeezing is triggered by chemicals called prostaglandins that the lining releases. Higher prostaglandin levels mean stronger contractions and more pain, usually in the lower abdomen, lower back or thighs, and strongest in the first one or two days. Prostaglandins can also affect the gut and other parts of the body, which is why loose motions, nausea or headaches can come along with a period. Doctors call period pain dysmenorrhoea. It is common, especially in the teens and twenties.
body.hg: Apni lining bahar nikaalne ke liye uterus, jo ek muscle hai, squeeze karta hai. Yeh squeezing prostaglandins naam ke chemicals se trigger hoti hai, jo lining khud release karti hai. Prostaglandins jitne zyada, contractions utne strong aur pain utna zyada. Dard usually lower abdomen, kamar ya thighs mein hota hai aur pehle ek-do din sabse tez rehta hai. Prostaglandins gut aur body ke doosre parts pe bhi asar kar sakte hain, isiliye period ke saath loose motions, nausea ya headache ho sakta hai. Doctors period pain ko dysmenorrhoea kehte hain. Yeh common hai, khaaskar teens aur twenties mein.

body.en: Heat works: a hot water bottle or warm bath relaxes the muscle. Gentle movement such as walking, stretching or yoga increases blood flow and often eases pain, though rest is fine when you need it. Anti-inflammatory pain-relief medicines reduce prostaglandins, so they tend to work best when taken as the pain begins; ask a doctor or pharmacist which one suits you and follow the label, especially if you have asthma or stomach problems. Regular sleep, enough water and iron-rich food such as green leafy vegetables, dals, chana and eggs support the body through bleeding.
body.hg: Heat kaam karti hai: hot water bottle ya gungune paani se nahana muscle ko relax karta hai. Walking, stretching ya yoga jaisi halki movement blood flow badhati hai aur aksar pain kam karti hai, waise zaroorat lage toh rest karna bhi theek hai. Anti-inflammatory pain-relief medicines prostaglandins kam karti hain, isliye dard shuru hote hi lene par zyada asar karti hain. Kaunsi medicine aapke liye sahi hai, yeh doctor ya pharmacist se poochho aur label follow karo, khaaskar agar asthma ya pet ki problem hai. Achhi neend, kaafi paani aur iron-rich khana, jaise hari patti wali sabziyan, dal, chana aur ande, bleeding ke dino mein body ko support karte hain.

h.hg: PMS: period se pehle wala hafta

body.en: Premenstrual syndrome, PMS, is a set of physical and emotional changes in the one to two weeks before a period, linked to the hormone shifts after ovulation. Common ones are bloating, tender breasts, pimples, food cravings, tiredness, irritability, low mood and crying easily. They ease within a few days of bleeding starting. PMS is real, but it does not make anyone irrational, and it should never be used to dismiss what a person is saying. Noting symptoms across two or three cycles shows whether they truly follow the cycle.
body.hg: Premenstrual syndrome yaani PMS, period se ek-do hafte pehle hone wale physical aur emotional changes ka set hai, jo ovulation ke baad ke hormone shifts se juda hai. Common symptoms hain bloating, breasts mein tenderness, pimples, food cravings, thakaan, chidchidapan, low mood aur jaldi rona aa jaana. Bleeding start hone ke kuch dino mein yeh halke pad jaate hain. PMS real hai, par isse koi irrational nahi ho jaata, aur kisi ki baat ko 'PMS hoga' bolkar dismiss karna galat hai. Do-teen cycles tak symptoms note karne se pata chalta hai ki woh sach mein cycle ke saath chalte hain ya nahi.

h.en: PMDD and pain that is not okay
h.hg: PMDD aur woh pain jo okay nahi hai

body.en: Premenstrual dysphoric disorder, PMDD, is a much more severe form. In the week or two before a period it brings intense sadness, hopelessness, anger or anxiety that disrupts studies, work and relationships, then lifts after bleeding begins. It is a recognised health condition with treatments, not a weakness. See a doctor if mood symptoms feel unmanageable, or if pain makes you miss school, vomit or faint, is not eased by usual measures, or keeps getting worse. If thoughts of harming yourself appear, call Tele-MANAS on 14416 or tell a trusted adult right away.
body.hg: Premenstrual dysphoric disorder yaani PMDD iska kahin zyada severe form hai. Period se ek-do hafte pehle isme itni intense udaasi, hopelessness, gussa ya anxiety hoti hai ki padhai, kaam aur relationships disturb ho jaate hain, aur bleeding start hone ke baad yeh hat jaati hai. Yeh ek recognised health condition hai jiska treatment hai; yeh weakness nahi hai. Doctor ko dikhao agar mood symptoms sambhal na rahe hon, ya pain ki wajah se school miss ho, ulti ho ya behoshi aaye, usual upaayon se aaram na mile, ya dard badhta hi jaye. Agar khud ko nuksaan pahunchane ke khayal aayein, toh turant Tele-MANAS 14416 pe call karo ya kisi trusted adult ko batao.

claim.en: Period pain goes away after marriage or childbirth, so there is no point treating it now.
claim.hg: Shaadi ya bachche ke baad period pain apne aap theek ho jaata hai, toh abhi treatment ki zaroorat nahi.

fact.en: Cramps ease with age or after childbirth for some people, not all, and conditions such as endometriosis do not disappear that way. Pain can be assessed and treated now; years of suffering have no benefit.
fact.hg: Kuch logon mein age ke saath ya bachche ke baad cramps kam hote hain, sab mein nahi, aur endometriosis jaisi conditions aise theek nahi hoti. Pain ka check-up aur treatment abhi ho sakta hai; saalon sehne ka koi fayda nahi.

takeaways.en: Cramps come from prostaglandins making the uterus muscle contract.
takeaways.hg: Cramps isliye hote hain kyunki prostaglandins uterus ki muscle ko contract karwate hain.

takeaways.en: Heat, gentle movement and suitable pain relief taken early are proven ways to feel better.
takeaways.hg: Heat, halki movement aur time pe li gayi sahi pain-relief medicine aaram ke proven tareeke hain.

takeaways.en: Pain that stops normal life or mood changes that feel unmanageable deserve a doctor's attention.
takeaways.hg: Jo pain normal life rok de ya jo mood sambhal na raha ho, uske liye doctor ko dikhana chahiye.

activity.en: Write a comfort plan for day one: three things that ease cramps for you or for someone close to you, and what you would do if they did not work.
activity.hg: Day one ke liye ek comfort plan likho: teen cheezein jo aapke ya aapke kisi close insaan ke cramps kam karti hain, aur agar woh kaam na karein toh aap kya karoge.

q.en: What makes the uterus cramp during a period?
q.hg: Period mein uterus mein cramps kis wajah se hote hain?

options.en: Cold food and cold drinks
Blood getting stuck inside the body
options.hg: Body ke andar blood ka atak jaana

options.en: Prostaglandins released by the uterus lining
options.hg: Uterus ki lining se nikalne wale prostaglandins

options.en: Too much exercise the week before

explain.en: Prostaglandins make the uterus muscle contract to shed its lining. Food temperature and exercise do not cause cramps.
explain.hg: Prostaglandins lining nikaalne ke liye uterus ki muscle ko contract karwate hain. Khane ke thande-garam hone ya exercise se cramps nahi hote.

q.en: Riya feels deeply hopeless for a week before every period, and it lifts once bleeding starts. What is the best next step?
q.hg: Riya ko har period se ek hafta pehle bahut hopeless feel hota hai, aur bleeding start hote hi yeh hat jaata hai. Best next step kya hai?

options.en: Ignore it, because everyone feels this way
options.hg: Ignore karna, kyunki sabko aisa hi lagta hai

options.en: See a doctor and take notes of symptoms across cycles
options.hg: Doctor ko dikhana aur kai cycles ke symptoms ke notes saath le jaana

options.en: Stop eating sour food before periods
options.hg: Period se pehle khatta khana band kar dena

options.en: Wait a few years for it to settle on its own
options.hg: Kuch saal wait karna ki apne aap theek ho jaye

explain.en: Severe mood symptoms that follow the cycle can be PMDD, which is treatable. Symptom notes help a doctor see the pattern.
explain.hg: Cycle ke saath chalne wale severe mood symptoms PMDD ho sakte hain, jiska treatment possible hai. Symptom notes se doctor ko pattern samajhne mein help milti hai.

warning.en: Pain that stops normal activity, or premenstrual mood changes with thoughts of self-harm, need medical help. Tele-MANAS: 14416. Emergency: 112.
warning.hg: Jo pain normal activity rok de, ya period se pehle aise mood changes jinme khud ko nuksaan pahunchane ke khayal aayein, unke liye medical help zaroori hai. Tele-MANAS: 14416. Emergency: 112.

title.en: Pads, Tampons, Cups: Choosing and Using Them Safely
title.hg: Pads, Tampons, Cups: Choose Karna aur Safely Use Karna

subtitle.en: An honest comparison, including toxic shock syndrome
subtitle.hg: Honest comparison, toxic shock syndrome ke saath

hook.en: There is no best period product, only the one that fits your body, your budget and your washroom situation.
hook.hg: Koi ek 'best' period product nahi hota; best wahi hai jo aapki body, budget aur washroom situation mein fit ho.

objectives.en: Compare pads, cloth pads, tampons and menstrual cups.
objectives.hg: Pads, cloth pads, tampons aur menstrual cups compare kar sako.
Body ke andar lagne wale products safely use karna jaano.

objectives.en: Recognise the warning signs of toxic shock syndrome.
objectives.hg: Toxic shock syndrome ke warning signs pehchaano.

body.en: Disposable pads are worn outside the body and are the easiest to start with. Reusable cloth pads and period underwear cost less over time but need soap, water and full drying in sunlight. Tampons are small absorbent plugs worn inside the vagina; they allow swimming and cannot be felt when placed correctly. Menstrual cups are flexible cups, usually medical-grade silicone, that collect blood instead of absorbing it and can be reused for years. Low-cost pads are sold at Jan Aushadhi stores and supplied through ASHA workers in many areas.
body.hg: Disposable pads body ke bahar lagte hain aur start karne ke liye sabse easy hain. Reusable cloth pads aur period underwear long term mein saste padte hain, par inke liye sabun, paani aur dhoop mein poora sukhana zaroori hai. Tampon ek chhota absorbent plug hai jo vagina ke andar lagta hai; iske saath swimming ho sakti hai aur sahi laga ho toh feel nahi hota. Menstrual cup ek flexible cup hai, usually medical-grade silicone ka, jo blood ko absorb nahi balki collect karta hai aur saalon chalta hai. Kai areas mein low-cost pads Jan Aushadhi stores pe milte hain aur ASHA workers ke through bhi pahunchaye jaate hain.

body.en: Use the lowest absorbency that manages your flow, and change the tampon every 4 to 8 hours; never leave one in longer. Wash hands before and after. A tampon cannot get lost inside, because the opening of the cervix at the top of the vagina is far too small for it to pass. If the string cannot be found, a doctor can remove the tampon easily, so do not delay out of embarrassment. Dryness or pain while removing usually means the absorbency is higher than you need.
body.hg: Apne flow ke liye jitni kam absorbency kaafi ho, wahi tampon lo, aur use har 4 se 8 ghante mein change karo; isse zyada der kabhi mat chhodo. Lagane se pehle aur baad mein haath dho lo. Tampon andar kho nahi sakta, kyunki vagina ke top pe cervix ka opening itna chhota hota hai ki woh usme se nikal hi nahi sakta. Agar string na mile, toh doctor tampon easily nikaal dete hain, isliye sharam ki wajah se delay mat karo. Nikaalte time dryness ya pain ho, toh usually iska matlab hai absorbency aapki zaroorat se zyada hai.

body.en: A cup is folded, placed in the vagina, and opens to form a light seal. It is emptied, rinsed with clean water and reinserted, as often as the maker's instructions say, and sterilised in boiling water between periods. Cups come in sizes, and learning to use one comfortably often takes two or three cycles. They need access to clean water and a private washroom, which matters in hostels and while travelling. People who use a copper or hormonal IUD should ask their doctor before using a cup, as removing a cup carelessly can pull on the IUD strings.
body.hg: Cup ko fold karke vagina mein rakha jaata hai, jahan woh khulkar ek halki si seal bana leta hai. Company ke instructions mein jitni baar likha ho, utni baar use khaali karke clean paani se dhoya aur dobara lagaya jaata hai, aur do periods ke beech ubalte paani mein sterilise kiya jaata hai. Cups alag-alag sizes mein aate hain, aur comfortably use karna seekhne mein aksar do-teen cycles lag jaate hain. Inke liye clean paani aur private washroom chahiye, jo hostel aur travel mein sochne wali baat hai. Jo log copper ya hormonal IUD use karte hain, woh cup lene se pehle doctor se pooch lein, kyunki laparwahi se cup nikaalne par IUD ke strings khinch sakte hain.

body.en: Tampons and cups do not change virginity, which is not a medical condition at all. The hymen is thin, stretchy tissue that varies from person to person and cannot show whether someone has had sex. Skip scented pads, sprays and douches, which can irritate the vulva. Toxic shock syndrome, TSS, is a rare but serious infection linked to products left inside too long. Sudden high fever, a sunburn-like rash, vomiting, diarrhoea or dizziness while using a tampon or cup means remove it and get urgent medical care.
body.hg: Tampons aur cups se 'virginity' pe koi asar nahi padta; virginity koi medical condition hai hi nahi. Hymen ek patla, stretchy tissue hai jo har insaan mein alag hota hai aur yeh kabhi nahi bata sakta ki kisi ne sex kiya hai ya nahi. Scented pads, sprays aur douches skip karo; inse vulva irritate ho sakti hai. Toxic shock syndrome (TSS) rare par serious infection hai, jo andar bahut der tak chhode gaye products se juda hai. Tampon ya cup lage hone par achanak tez bukhaar, sunburn jaisa rash, ulti, loose motions ya chakkar aaye, toh use nikaalo aur turant medical care lo.

claim.en: Scented or more expensive period products are more hygienic.
claim.hg: Scented ya mehenge period products zyada hygienic hote hain.

fact.en: Hygiene comes from changing products on time and clean hands, not price or perfume. Added fragrance does nothing for cleanliness and is a common cause of itching and rashes.
fact.hg: Hygiene time pe product change karne aur clean haathon se aati hai, price ya perfume se nahi. Fragrance se cleanliness mein koi farak nahi padta, ulta yeh khujli aur rashes ka common reason hai.

takeaways.en: Pads, cloth pads, tampons and cups are all valid; choose by comfort, cost and access to water.
takeaways.hg: Pads, cloth pads, tampons aur cups sab valid options hain; comfort, cost aur paani ki facility dekhkar choose karo.

takeaways.en: Change tampons every 4 to 8 hours and follow the instructions that come with a cup.
takeaways.hg: Tampon har 4 se 8 ghante mein change karo aur cup ke saath aaye instructions follow karo.

takeaways.en: Sudden fever, rash, vomiting or dizziness while using an internal product means remove it and get urgent care.
takeaways.hg: Internal product use karte time achanak bukhaar, rash, ulti ya chakkar aaye toh use nikaal kar turant care lo.

activity.en: Estimate what your household spends on period products in a year, then compare it with one reusable option and note what washroom access that option would need.
activity.hg: Estimate karo ki aapke ghar mein saal bhar mein period products pe kitna kharcha hota hai, phir ek reusable option se compare karo aur note karo ki uske liye kaisi washroom facility chahiye.

q.en: How often should a tampon be changed?
q.hg: Tampon kitni der mein change karna chahiye?

options.en: Once a day
Only when it starts to leak
options.hg: Sirf tab jab leak hone lage

options.en: Every 12 to 16 hours
Every 4 to 8 hours

explain.en: Changing every 4 to 8 hours keeps the risk of infection, including toxic shock syndrome, low.
explain.hg: Har 4 se 8 ghante mein change karne se infection ka risk, jisme toxic shock syndrome bhi shaamil hai, low rehta hai.

q.en: A tampon can travel beyond the vagina and get lost inside the body.
q.hg: Tampon vagina se aage jaakar body ke andar kho sakta hai.

options.en: True
False

explain.en: The opening of the cervix is far too small for a tampon to pass. If it is hard to reach, a doctor can remove it.
explain.hg: Cervix ka opening itna chhota hota hai ki tampon usme se nahi nikal sakta. Haath na pahunche toh doctor use nikaal sakte hain.

warning.en: Sudden high fever, rash, vomiting or dizziness while using a tampon or cup can be toxic shock syndrome. Remove the product and get urgent medical care.
warning.hg: Tampon ya cup use karte time achanak tez bukhaar, rash, ulti ya chakkar toxic shock syndrome ho sakta hai. Product nikaalo aur turant medical care lo.

title.en: When a Period Needs a Doctor
title.hg: Jab Period ko Doctor ki Zaroorat Ho

subtitle.en: Heavy bleeding, irregular cycles, PCOS and endometriosis
subtitle.hg: Heavy bleeding, irregular cycles, PCOS aur endometriosis

hook.en: Common is not the same as normal. Some period problems are quietly tolerated for years when they are treatable.
hook.hg: Common hona aur normal hona same nahi hai. Kuch period problems saalon chupchaap jheli jaati hain, jabki unka treatment hai.

objectives.en: List the signs that mean a period needs medical evaluation.
objectives.hg: Woh signs gina sako jin par period ka medical check-up zaroori hai.

objectives.en: Describe PCOS and endometriosis in plain words.
objectives.hg: PCOS aur endometriosis ko simple words mein samjha sako.

objectives.en: Prepare for a doctor's visit about periods.
objectives.hg: Periods ke baare mein doctor visit ki tayyari kar sako.

body.en: See a doctor if you soak through a pad or tampon every one to two hours, pass large clots repeatedly, or bleed for more than 7 days. Other reasons are pain that stops normal activity, bleeding between periods, periods that stop for three months or more, and no first period by 15. Heavy bleeding over months can drain the body's iron and cause anaemia, with tiredness, breathlessness, dizziness and pale skin. Heavy bleeding with fainting or a racing heartbeat is an emergency: go to a hospital straight away or call 112.
body.hg: Doctor ko dikhao agar har ek-do ghante mein pad ya tampon poora bheeg jaata ho, baar-baar bade clots aate hon, ya bleeding 7 din se zyada chalti ho. Doosre reasons hain: aisa pain jo normal kaam rok de, do periods ke beech bleeding, teen mahine ya usse zyada periods band rehna, aur 15 saal ki age tak first period na aana. Mahino tak heavy bleeding se body ka iron kam ho sakta hai aur anaemia (khoon ki kami) ho sakta hai, jisme thakaan, saans phoolna, chakkar aur skin ka peelapan hota hai. Heavy bleeding ke saath behoshi ya dil ki tez dhadkan ho, toh yeh emergency hai: turant hospital jao ya 112 pe call karo.

body.en: Irregular means cycles often shorter than 21 days, longer than 35 days in adults, or very unpredictable. In the first years after the first period this is usually just an immature hormone system. Later, common causes are stress, sudden weight loss or gain, very intense exercise, thyroid problems and PCOS. After sex or any genital contact, pregnancy is also possible: take a pregnancy test and see a doctor instead of waiting. If it was unwanted, or you are under 18, a trusted adult, 1098 (Child Helpline) or 181 (Women Helpline) can help. Otherwise one odd cycle is rarely a worry; a pattern across several months is worth a check-up.
body.hg: Irregular ka matlab hai aise cycles jo aksar 21 din se chhote hon, adults mein 35 din se lambe hon, ya bilkul unpredictable hon. First period ke baad ke shuruaati saalon mein iska reason usually bas itna hota hai ki hormone system abhi mature nahi hua. Baad mein common reasons hain stress, achanak weight kam ya zyada hona, bahut intense exercise, thyroid problems aur PCOS. Agar sex ya koi genital contact hua hai, toh pregnancy bhi ek reason ho sakti hai: wait karne ke bajaye pregnancy test karo aur doctor ko dikhao. Agar yeh aapki marzi ke bina hua, ya aapki age 18 se kam hai, toh koi trusted adult, 1098 (Child Helpline) ya 181 (Women Helpline) help kar sakte hain. Warna ek ajeeb cycle shayad hi tension ki baat ho; par kai mahine tak yahi pattern chale toh check-up karwana chahiye.

body.en: Polycystic ovary syndrome, PCOS, is one of the most common hormonal conditions in people who menstruate. The ovaries make more androgens than usual and ovulation becomes irregular. Signs include infrequent or missed periods, extra hair on the face, chest or abdomen, stubborn acne, thinning scalp hair and, for some, weight gain. A doctor diagnoses it from history, blood tests and sometimes an ultrasound; in teenagers they are careful, because irregular cycles are common anyway. PCOS has no cure but is manageable with lifestyle support and medicines, and thin people can have it too.
body.hg: Polycystic ovary syndrome yaani PCOS, periods wale logon mein sabse common hormonal conditions mein se ek hai. Isme ovaries normal se zyada androgens banati hain aur ovulation irregular ho jaata hai. Signs hain periods ka der-der se aana ya miss hona, face, chest ya pet pe extra baal, ziddi acne, sar ke baalon ka patla hona aur kuch logon mein weight gain. Doctor ise history, blood tests aur kabhi-kabhi ultrasound se diagnose karte hain; teenagers mein woh careful rehte hain, kyunki us age mein irregular cycles waise bhi common hain. PCOS ka cure nahi hai, par lifestyle support aur medicines se manage ho jaata hai, aur yeh duble logon ko bhi ho sakta hai.

h.en: Endometriosis, and how to see a doctor
h.hg: Endometriosis, aur doctor se kaise milein

body.en: In endometriosis, tissue similar to the uterus lining grows outside the uterus, causing inflammation. Typical signs are severe period pain, long-lasting pelvic pain, pain while passing stool or urine during periods, and exhaustion. It is often dismissed as ordinary cramps for years. Treatments can control it. For any period concern you can see a gynaecologist, a general doctor, or an Adolescent Friendly Health Clinic at a government facility. Carry notes on cycle dates, pads used per day and pain. You can ask for a female doctor and for someone you trust to be present.
body.hg: Endometriosis mein uterus ki lining jaisa tissue uterus ke bahar grow karne lagta hai, jisse inflammation hoti hai. Typical signs hain bahut severe period pain, lambe time tak rehne wala pelvic pain, periods ke dauraan potty ya peshaab karte time dard, aur bahut zyada thakaan. Ise aksar saalon tak ordinary cramps bolkar taal diya jaata hai. Treatment se ise control mein rakha ja sakta hai. Period ki kisi bhi problem ke liye aap gynaecologist, general doctor ya sarkari hospital ke Adolescent Friendly Health Clinic (AFHC) ja sakte ho. Cycle dates, roz kitne pads lage aur pain ke notes saath le jao. Aap female doctor ke liye aur apne kisi trusted insaan ko saath rakhne ke liye bol sakte ho.

claim.en: Irregular periods or PCOS mean you can never have children.
claim.hg: Irregular periods ya PCOS ka matlab hai kabhi bachche nahi ho sakte.

fact.en: PCOS can make ovulation less frequent, so conceiving may take longer, but many people with PCOS do become pregnant, some with medical help. Irregular cycles alone say little about future fertility.
fact.hg: PCOS mein ovulation kam baar ho sakta hai, isliye conceive karne mein zyada time lag sakta hai, par PCOS wale bahut log pregnant hote hain, kuch medical help se. Sirf irregular cycles se future fertility ke baare mein zyada kuch pata nahi chalta.

takeaways.en: Soaking a pad every one to two hours, bleeding beyond 7 days, disabling pain or a three-month gap all need a doctor.
takeaways.hg: Har ek-do ghante mein pad bheegna, 7 din se zyada bleeding, kaam rok dene wala pain ya teen mahine ka gap, in sab par doctor ko dikhana chahiye.

takeaways.en: PCOS and endometriosis are common, real and manageable, but they are often diagnosed late.
takeaways.hg: PCOS aur endometriosis common hain, real hain aur manage ho sakte hain, par aksar late diagnose hote hain.

takeaways.en: Notes on dates, flow and pain make a doctor's visit far more useful.
takeaways.hg: Dates, flow aur pain ke notes doctor visit ko kahin zyada useful bana dete hain.

activity.en: Write down the dates of your last three periods, or help a family member do it, and tick whether any red flag from this lesson applies.
activity.hg: Apne last teen periods ki dates likho, ya family mein kisi ki likhne mein help karo, aur check karo ki is lesson ka koi red flag apply hota hai ya nahi.

q.en: Which of these needs a doctor's visit?
q.hg: Inme se kis situation mein doctor ko dikhana zaroori hai?

options.en: Brown spotting on the last day
A cycle that is 30 days long
Soaking a pad every one to two hours
options.hg: Har ek-do ghante mein pad ka poora bheeg jaana

options.en: Mild cramps on the first day

explain.en: Soaking a pad or tampon every one to two hours is heavy bleeding and can lead to anaemia. The other three are within the normal range.
explain.hg: Har ek-do ghante mein pad ya tampon bheeg jaana heavy bleeding hai aur isse anaemia ho sakta hai. Baaki teeno normal range mein aate hain.

q.en: Only people who are overweight can have PCOS.
q.hg: PCOS sirf overweight logon ko hota hai.

options.en: True
False

explain.en: PCOS is a hormonal condition that occurs at every body size. Weight gain is a sign for some people, not a requirement.
explain.hg: PCOS ek hormonal condition hai jo har body size mein ho sakti hai. Weight gain kuch logon mein ek sign hai, koi shart nahi.

warning.en: Very heavy bleeding with fainting, a racing heartbeat or breathlessness is an emergency: go to the nearest hospital now or call 112.
warning.hg: Bahut heavy bleeding ke saath behoshi, tez dhadkan ya saans phoolna ho, toh yeh emergency hai: turant nearest hospital jao ya 112 pe call karo.
